name: Invitation
subject: {{organization.name}} invited you to join VolunTime
heading: You have an invite
html:
{{organization.name}} invited you to join the {{invite.targetKind}} {{invite.targetName}} as {{invite.roleName}}.

Your username will be {{user.username}}.

Use this code to accept the invite:

{{invite.code}}

The code expires in 7 days.

Enter the code at {{invite.url}}

name: Account welcome
subject: Your account for {{organization.name}}
heading: Your account is ready
preview: Your temporary password for {{organization.name}} is inside.
html:
An administrator created a VolunTime account for you at {{organization.name}}.

Username: {{user.username}}

Temporary password: {{user.password}}

You will choose a new password the first time you sign in.

Sign in at {{account.url}}

name: Password reset
subject: Your VolunTime password reset code
heading: Reset your password
preview: Your VolunTime password reset code is inside.
html:
Use this code to reset your VolunTime password:

{{reset.code}}

The code expires in 15 minutes. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

Enter the code at {{reset.url}}

name: Hours logged
subject: Your hours for {{organization.name}} were saved
heading: Hours logged
html:
Hi {{user.firstName}},

{{entry.hours}} hours were saved on {{entry.date}}.

Review your hours

name: Unclassified time
subject: Please classify your volunteer time
heading: Unclassified time
preview: Your last time entry needs a project, task category, or group.
html:
Hi {{user.firstName}}, your last timer save has no project, task category, or group. Classify it or delete it so grant reports stay accurate.

Review unclassified entries

name: Feedback received
subject: Thanks for your {{feedback.typeLabel}}
heading: We got your feedback
html:
Hi {{user.firstName}},

Thank you for sending this {{feedback.typeLabel}}: {{feedback.title}}. We read every report and use it to make VolunTime better.

We will email you again if this is completed.

name: Feedback completed
subject: Update on your {{feedback.typeLabel}}
heading: Your feedback is complete
html:
Hi {{user.firstName}},

About your {{feedback.typeLabel}} "{{feedback.title}}": {{feedback.outcome}}.

{{feedback.note}}

Thank you for helping us improve VolunTime.

name: Access request (admins)
subject: Access request for {{organization.name}}
heading: Access request
html: {{request.requesterEmail}} requested more access in {{organization.name}}. Review the request in People settings.

name: Access request decided
subject: Your access request was {{request.decision}}
heading: Access request update
preview: Your request for more access in {{organization.name}} was {{request.decision}}.
html: Hi {{user.name}}, your request for more access in {{organization.name}} was {{request.decision}}.

name: Message to volunteers
subject: {{message.subject}}
heading: {{need.name}}
html:
{{message.body}}

This message is about a volunteer need you signed up for. You are not on a mailing list.
